questions.answer: No; feasible limits and suitable alternative routes matter.

questions.prompt: How does peer help differ from clinical care?
questions.answer: Peer support addresses ordinary needs and access; clinical care requires qualifications.

questions.prompt: Does empathy require continued unsafe contact?
questions.answer: No; safety and autonomy take priority.

questions.feedback: Do not rely only on routine follow-up.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Selects feasible, compassionate assistance with consent, role limits, alternative routes and safety boundaries.
scoring.transfer: Complete the listening role-play or written equivalent with perspective-taking, reflective listening, respectful disagreement and compassionate limits. Include a correction, a bounded offer, alternative support and a scenario requiring qualified or emergency help. Revise after feedback.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
